verdict.rationale: Two-stage timer accepted: presentation-only hint expiry plus backend-derived AUTH_CALLBACK_ACCEPTANCE_SECONDS=600 acceptance deadline, retention ref entered only from hint expiry. Beacon moves to acceptance expiry to preserve the EPMCDME-14226 metric. Predicate split 3-keep/1-widen. 8 acceptance criteria.

7 test-first implementation tasks accepted; no task duplicates a pipeline stage. AUTH_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT_MESSAGE rename ripple across 5 test files acknowledged; WorkflowDetailsPage covered by a new sibling test file.

Fix all 4 findings inline. CR-002 (critical): untrack clears only the hint timer, leaving the acceptance timer armed and retention unpurged - false/duplicated timeout beacons, retry retention purged mid-window, timer outliving unmount. CR-001: acceptance window computed inline while getAuthCallbackAcceptanceMs has no production caller. CR-003: add the AC 6 retry-after-hint-expiry pin for the chat consumer. CR-004 resolved by user against the approved spec: widen the rollback matcher too, guarded so it applies late errors only to rows not already authenticated - preserving the spec intent (never clobber an authenticated row) while restoring parity with useMCPAuthPrompt.

CR-001/003/004 confirmed resolved. CR-002 residual: after a hint-expiry rollback the id is already out of trackedAuthConfigIds, so a later cancel/clearRows/chat switch produces no untrack transition and none of the four retention purge routes fires - false timeout beacon plus a late success misrouted to whichever chat is open. User chose reviewer option B: scope each retained entry to its originating context (store the originating chat id, dispatch through the handler captured at track time rather than the current ref), plus the two missing tests (cancel-after-hint-expiry sends no beacon and accepts no late callback; chat switch after hint expiry still applies the late success to the originating chat). No third automated round - user reviews the resulting diff directly.

Accepted unverified with caveat, by explicit user decision. Six user-visible scenarios INCONCLUSIVE - not verified, not passed. Cause is environmental, not the change: no backend on :8080 (/api/v1/config and /api/v1/user return 500, app renders empty body), and npm run test-harness exited 0 but produced 79 errors / 0 passed with ConnectionRefusedError [Errno 111] against CODEMIE_API_DOMAIN=http://localhost:8080; AWS credentials not configured. No Playwright test was generated - stubbing backend, MCP server, IdP and callback postMessage would assert against its own fixtures and duplicate the green Vitest integration suite. Verified WITHOUT a browser: the 600 s acceptance constant matches the real backend sources (_PKCE_TTL_SECONDS 600 in codemie-enterprise redis_pkce_store.py, _CALLBACK_STATE_MAX_AGE 10 min in codemie enterprise/mcp_auth/_constants.py, DISCOVERED_FLOW_TTL_SECONDS 900 the looser bound), closing the Stage 1 risk that these were unverifiable from this tree; and WorkflowDetailsPage.tsx:64 verify-only contract holds. MR must state local verification was impossible, link evidence/verification/*.json, and ask the reviewer to post /sanity against a real environment.
